🏆 Leaderboard
🏆 Leaderboard & Brownlow Votes
AFL Fantasy Brownlow simulates the Brownlow Medal using Fantasy scores — the top 3 scorers in each game each round receive 3, 2 and 1 votes respectively.

Columns explained:
  • Current Price — the player's current AFL Fantasy price.
  • Avg FP — average Fantasy Points scored per round played.
  • Total FP — cumulative Fantasy Points across all rounds loaded.
  • Votes — total simulated Brownlow votes. Ties broken by Total FP.
Click any player name to jump to their full stats in the Player Stats tab.

📅 Fixtures
📅 Fixtures
One timeline — pick any round, played or upcoming. Click a game to focus on it; click again to clear.

Played rounds: every player's result — score, price change, votes, and how far above/below their season average they landed.

Upcoming rounds: projected score, position matchup difficulty, and an estimated price change. Price change is a rough model (score vs breakeven × a fixed value per point) — treat it as a guide, not gospel.

Click any column heading to sort by that stat.

      🏉 My Team Analyser
      Add your 22-player squad. Players go into their position groups — DEF, MID, RUC, FWD — with the last 4 in each being bench (shaded). Add up to 30 players total.

      Click Analyse for ranked upgrade suggestions with trade pairs, using form, fixture, value, consistency, and bench context. Each card shows signal, avg FP, price trend, fixture, and best available replacement.
      🔍
      🎯 Upgrade Recommendations — ranked by impact
      🏆 Rolling 22 — Best Projected Team
      🏆 Rolling 22
      Shows the best projected 22-man AFL Fantasy team from your loaded data, laid out in DEF/MID/RUC/FWD formation, ranked by the same projected average used everywhere else in the app (recent form + fixture difficulty for the rest of the season).

      DPP players are placed into whichever eligible position is scarcest rather than always their first-listed position. Bench spots show the next-best available.
      🏅 Season Awards
      🏅 Season Awards
      A quick season-long records board, pulled from every round loaded so far. "Best value" and "Best bargain" both use price — value is against today's price, bargain is against the price they started the season at.
      🎯 Targets
      🎯 Targets
      Every eligible player, grouped by price tier and ranked by what actually matters for that tier — best target at the top of each column.

      Premiums ($800K+): pure scoring output — projected average for the rest of the season, fixture-adjusted across every remaining game.

      Mid Price ($350K–$800K): a blend of season average and near-term matchup ease, weighted heavily toward the next few games — these are short-term trade targets.

      Rookies (under $350K): projected cumulative price growth for the rest of the season — best cash-generation targets.

      Every priced player with at least one game falls into one of the three columns; injured/suspended players are left out since they're not real trade targets right now.

      Find Players ignores the tier boundaries — set any price range, position, or team and it ranks everyone who matches by projected average for the rest of the season.
